titleEn: Find Players With Zero or One Losses
title: 找出输掉零场或一场比赛的玩家
summary: 根据胜负记录，返回从未输过的参赛者和恰输一场的参赛者，两列表均升序。
insight: 所有胜负双方加入参赛集合，败者频次加一；按有序 Map 扫描，频次零进第一表、频次一进第二表。
pitfalls: 只在败者位置增加负场数
从未作为败者但参加过的玩家要计入零负

solutions.title: 有序负场频次
solutions.idea: 用 TreeMap 同时登记参与者并统计败场。
steps: 升序遍历，value==0 加 zeroLoss，value==1 加 oneLoss

code.java: class Solution { public List<List<Integer>> findWinners(int[][] matches){Map<Integer,Integer> losses=new TreeMap<>();for(int[] match:matches){losses.putIfAbsent(match[0],0);losses.merge(match[1],1,Integer::sum);}List<Integer> zero=new ArrayList<>(),one=new ArrayList<>();for(Map.Entry<Integer,Integer> entry:losses.entrySet())if(entry.getValue()==0)zero.add(entry.getKey());else if(entry.getValue()==1)one.add(entry.getKey());return Arrays.asList(zero,one);} }
code.kotlin: class Solution { fun findWinners(matches:Array<IntArray>):List<List<Int>>{val losses=java.util.TreeMap<Int,Int>();for(match in matches){losses.putIfAbsent(match[0],0);losses[match[1]]=(losses[match[1]]?:0)+1};val zero=mutableListOf<Int>();val one=mutableListOf<Int>();for((player,count) in losses)if(count==0)zero.add(player)else if(count==1)one.add(player);return listOf(zero,one)} }
code.cpp: class Solution { public:vector<vector<int>> findWinners(vector<vector<int>>& matches){map<int,int> losses;for(auto& match:matches){losses.try_emplace(match[0],0);++losses[match[1]];}vector<vector<int>> answer(2);for(auto [player,count]:losses)if(!count)answer[0].push_back(player);else if(count==1)answer[1].push_back(player);return answer;} };
